title: pyEUVTools: EUV Instrument Response Tools
description: pyEUVTools is a SunCAST Python package for building, inspecting, and exporting EUV instrument response products. It is designed as a reusable response-function layer for the broader SunCAST Python ecosystem, is maintained in the suncast-org GitHub organization, and starts with AIA time-dependent response support before evolving toward generalized multi-instrument EUV response tooling.
notes: Release metadata for the 0.2.0 feature release. Zenodo should archive the GitHub release under the suncast-org repository while crediting Gelu M. Nita as the named creator in this metadata. This release expands the static GX-compatible response layer with Solar Orbiter/EUI, Yohkoh/SXT, and TRACE support.
